The Crucial X9 Portable SSD is more durable and dependable than fragile portable hard drives. The X9 is built to withstand temperature fluctuations and is shock, vibration, and drop-proof up to 7.5 feet. The Crucial X9 Portable SSD, designed by Micron®, is lightweight yet durable in a 65 x 50 mm polycarbonate design with an integrated lanyard hole for ultimate portability.

MSI’s R&D and engineering teams have reviewed countless designs, evaluated a wide selection of high-quality components, and developed products for reliability even under extreme conditions. Designed to support the most popular All-In-One & customized water cooling solutions on the market. MSI motherboards are built with a variety of connectors to satisfy gamers. Enhanced audio, advanced LAN networking capabilities, USB and Mystic Light turn any gaming experience into an immersive one. 2.5Gbps LAN provides incredible data transfer speed faster than general Gigabit LAN. This is a premium solution for demanding users.

The Logitech MX Keys S Wireless Keyboard is a high-performance wireless keyboard designed for productivity, comfort, and precision. Whether you’re a professional typist or a casual user, this keyboard offers several features to enhance your typing experience.
Fingertip-Shaped Keys for Precise Typing The Logitech MX Keys S Keyboard features spherically-dished keys that match the shape of your fingertips. This design minimizes the chances of mistypes and ensures a comfortable typing experience. The rounded edges provide satisfying feedback, regardless of where you strike the key.
Smart Illumination Day or night, the Logitech MX Keys S adapts to your environment. Proximity sensors automatically light up the keys when your hand approaches, and the backlighting adjusts to changing lighting conditions. When you leave your desk, the keys fade to save power.
Programmable Keys and Smarter Fn Keys Customize your workflow with programmable shortcut keys. The MX Keys S allows you to assign functions to the entire F-row, including regular F-key functions, special actions, or app-specific customizations. The new Smarter Fn keys also let you send emojis, mute/unmute your mic, and activate talk-to-text.
Ergonomic Design for Comfort Crafted with a low-profile design and an optimum keyboard angle, the Logitech MX Keys S encourages better wrist posture and reduces strain on your joints. The minimalist form factor aligns your shoulders and allows you to place your mouse closer to the keyboard for improved ergonomics.
Connectivity and Rechargeability Connect via Bluetooth or USB-C, and enjoy seamless multi-device switching. The keyboard is rechargeable, eliminating the need for disposable batteries.
Compatibility The Logitech MX Keys S works with Windows PC, Linux, Chrome, and Mac systems.
Pricing and Availability The Logitech MX Keys S Wireless Keyboard is available for purchase on AMTradez website. The price of Logitech MX Keys S Wireless Keyboard in Like New Condition is AED 379.00 (incl. VAT).

3. Does it ask for accessories or parts COMPATIBLE WITH a NAMED reference product? -> compatible_product_search
4. Does it ask for the CHEAPEST / LOWEST-PRICE option?
   4a. ...of a NAMED product (no extra constraints) -> cheapest_product_search

   4c. ...matching a VAGUE use-case ('for gaming', 'for office') -> cheapest_vague_search
5. Does it NAME a concrete product (brand + model)? -> specific_product_search
